explanation: Frequency must be maintained close to 50 Hz to ensure stable grid operation and prevent cascading failures.
Voltage must remain within technical limits to avoid equipment damage and ensure reliable power delivery.
The reliability standard requires that up to 0.002% of demand may be unserved, meaning the system must meet at least 99.998% of demand; thus the condition should be ≤ 0.002% rather than > 0.002%.

source: AEMO’s Minimum Operational Demand Thresholds in South Australia report
explanation: Negative operational demand may compromise system inertia, voltage control, and restoration capabilities due to reduced synchronous generation participation.
